fixtureBoundaries: Only the isolated registered poms-r4ghi namespace and proven owned real parents; no Native process writing the Rust database
At most one new exact legacy authority PK per witness; no mutation, reparenting, deletion or status change of an existing business row
Do not weaken or disable cross-producer unique indexes, FK/parent guards, catalog/ACL or trigger rules
No guessed financial values or currency; no backdated created/effective timestamps; use actual database clock
producer0 remains unverified: directFixtureSQL=true, actualHistoricalData=false, businessProducerDelivery=false, counted32Producer=false
A synthetic negative contender never qualifies a positive period or promotes an old source into a modern authority
requiredActualOrderingAndEvidence: Acquire one Root nonce lock before mutable state/context; persist the exact candidate PK, parent/version/source pins, SQL and request intent before effects
Lock the real project and all required actual parent/reference rows before the fixture INSERT; verify absence and exact parents under that same transaction
Run one actual modern HTTP contender while the fixture transaction retains the project lock

Record actual pg_stat_activity/pg_blocking_pids or equivalent controlled-barrier evidence linking the waiting Rust application connection to the owned fixture backend PID; sequential calls do not qualify
Commit the one legacy fixture and observe the exact typed modern409; preserve actual configured request and response entity bytes

Attribute the external legacy SQL row by exact new PK, returned raw SHA/xmin and acknowledged transaction; never claim it was created by the rejected Rust request or mark it owned before commit acknowledgement

Validate the full joint delta: the single declared legacy fixture is the only external row, the rejected Rust command has no domain/audit/managed-auth commit, and any real independent raw-session precondition touch is separately proven and labelled
preciseRestoration: After known outcomes only, re-lock the same parents and verify the exact newly owned producer0 PK/raw/xmin before deleting that one fixture
Preserve each prior original row and its xmin; never repurpose an existing legacy fixture or remove an actual period/baseline
Capture full before/after rows, xmin, metadata, sequences and objects; account separately for actual raw-session touches
Use durable pending/ack records for INSERT, contender and DELETE; unknown commit requires exact reconciliation and never a blind replay
Keep all failed, partial and completed evidence with its true label; the new real witness project is retained for ordinary proven-owned batch cleanup
